title: Corrections and Upgrades to a Travel Protection Certificate
content:
A declared particular of the risk on a certificate of the Travel Protection Plans may be corrected while
the policy stands, and the premium follows the correction from the day it takes effect.

## The authority for an upgrade

Cover is upgraded only when the underwriting desk has already recorded an approved cover upgrade against this
policy. The authority is the policy service request standing against that policy in the agency's own records,
identified by its own request reference, and read before the amendment is made; what the traveller says about an
approval is not that authority.

## The terms of an amendment

1. An increase in the declared trip cost is accepted only up to the plan's ceiling, and a trip whose cost has
   grown beyond it is upgraded to a higher plan rather than amended.
2. An upgrade is available only on a plan that permits it and only inside the plan's upgrade window counted from
   issue; outside the window the traveller buys a second policy instead.
3. Adding an insured traveller is an amendment and re-rates the whole certificate, because the age loading
   follows the oldest traveller named.
4. No amendment is accepted once the journey has begun or once a claim has been filed, because the risk is then
   no longer uncertain.

## Points of judgement

| The situation | The answer |
|---|---|
| The declared trip cost has grown to a figure above the plan's ceiling | The plan is upgraded to a higher one rather than the certificate amended |
| The traveller asks to upgrade on a plan that permits it, 9 days after issue, the plan's window being 14 days | Inside the window, and an approved cover upgrade recorded by the underwriting desk is what permits it |
| The traveller asks to upgrade after the plan's window has closed | A second policy is bought instead |
| A grandmother is added to a party already on the road | No amendment is accepted once the journey has begun |
| A grandmother is added before departure | The whole certificate is re-rated, the age loading following the oldest traveller now named |
